stories.title: Musician’s tour bus involved in deadly collision in Florida
stories.summary: A 64-year-old man from Louisiana died after the car he was driving collided with a tour bus, according to Florida Highway Patrol troopers.

stories.title: Helemano Farms to open for Christmas tree season
stories.summary: Helemano Farms will open Saturday, Nov. 21, and Sunday, Nov. 22, from 10 a.m. to 6:30 p.m.

stories.title: Okinawan community honors former Hawaii transportation director
stories.summary: Former Hawaiʻi transportation director Ryokichi “Rick” Higashionna, 91, was honored for his contributions to the Okinawan community.

stories.title: Honolulu police chief takes first Skyline ride as city looks to expand transit security
stories.summary: While Skyline already has security measures in place, Lazar said he envisions a greater police presence on public transportation in the future.

stories.title: Case delayed after father charged in infant son’s death placed on suicide watch
stories.summary: A Hawaiʻi Island father charged in his infant son’s death appeared in court by video after being placed on suicide watch.

stories.title: United Airlines outage disrupts flights days after nationwide ground stop
stories.summary: United said there was no indication the outage was related to a cybersecurity issue.

stories.title: Ground stop sparks Thanksgiving travel concerns
stories.summary: Aging systems are being blamed for last week’s nation-wide ground stop that disrupted an estimated 46,000 flights. It comes as Americans gear up for the busiest travel week of the year.

stories.title: Pro skateboarder Jaime Reyes hosts event for Oahu students
stories.summary: 75 students from Kalākaua, Keʻelikōlani, and Kawananakoa Middle Schools got to skate with pro skateboarder Jaime Reyes at ʻAʻala Park.

stories.title: Former teacher pleads guilty in sexual abuse case involving 16-year-old student
stories.summary: Mary "Hanna" Mattingly, 32, would serve five years in prison under the plea agreement.

stories.title: Activist calls for new vote on temporary chair of Hawaii Elections Commission
stories.summary: Michael Golojuch Jr. alleges procedural violations, including no roll-call vote. Chair pro tem Tamara McKay says she’ll await a state review.

stories.title: Kauai County seeks farmers’ and ranchers’ input on Hurricane Lowell recovery
stories.summary: Kauaʻi is asking agricultural businesses to share their Hurricane Lowell impacts and recovery needs in a 10-minute survey.

stories.title: Kapaa DMV triples daily appointment capacity following September fire
stories.summary: County officials announced Monday that the number of available appointments increased from 75 to 225 per day.
